sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Spend ten active minutes closely inspecting one actual item with adequate sensory access and tools appropriate to safely examine it. NEW: make Intelligence (Investigation), DC10 for a plainly identifiable mundane object,15 for complex mundane construction,20 for an ordinary magical item, or25 for a unique unfamiliar construction; a specific item's explicit identification DC or concealment exception controls instead. Set the classification and actual information before rolling. On Success or Critical Success, learn its exact current reference value and complete discoverable operative properties, including magical properties and a curse unless that curse's specific source prevents this identification. Reference value means the recorded undamaged catalog price adjusted by the governing condition/valuation rule, or a Director-established local fair-market valuation when no catalog price exists, fixed before the roll. It is not a guaranteed purchase or sale offer. The property result states uses, limits, charges, activation and known operational risks from the actual item's complete record; it does not invent a missing profile, formula, historical truth or cosmology. A source explicitly resisting identification may withhold its protected part while other properties are identified. Safe appraisal is not activation or disarming; actual independent touch/proximity triggers remain. Failure spends time and yields no exact appraisal; another attempt needs changed evidence, access or method. This deliberately preserves a powerful item-identification benefit and requires direct comparison with Identify before adoption.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Time, DC tiers, value definition, magic/curse scope and explicit identification exceptions. Restricting any source's 'any item' promise requires the stated joint decision.
submittedWorkedCases: A known item with reference value40gp can be appraised at40gp while a real buyer offers only20gp. The feat identifies the reference value; it does not compel that buyer to pay40gp.

An ordinary magical wand's complete operative profile can be learned on the proposed DC20 success. An explicitly identification-proof curse remains protected by its own source; its lore is not invented.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW finite recruitment/loyalty procedure: during a real recruitment effort, designate up to current PB actual willing prospective followers or hirelings. Spend one active hour interviewing and briefing them, agree on their actual jobs, pay, duration, risk, equipment and departure terms, and gain+2 on any legitimate Persuasion checks to secure those agreements. An automatic willing agreement needs no roll. The feat creates no candidate, free wage, stat block, level, binding, summoned unit or extra class companion. operational.targets: Choose a point within 15 feet and line of effect for a fixed 15-foot-radius sphere. Each creature physically inside with line of effect from the center is eligible, including allies, yourself and unseen creatures; there is no individually perceived-target or shared-language requirement and no target roster diagnostic.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. A failed-save record restricts communication only while exposed to this fixed zone. In initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-turn START after application, excluding any start already underway/passed. Outside initiative, the maximum is 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve the original virtual marker/absolute deadline through initiative changes, extra turns, absence and planar travel; a timing-mode change never resets it.
operational.resolution: Use the actual casting class’s school/rank/price: Enchantment rank 2/base 3 RP for Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard or Paladin access; Divination rank 4/base 7 RP for Cleric, Ranger or Shaman access. Actual minimum class levels and repertoire still apply; paying another price does not grant the other placement. Both modes use a Charisma save. Each creature saves once at its first eligible exposure to this application, either on creation, entry or newly exposed line of effect while already geometrically inside. Success makes it unaffected by this cast for the cast’s remainder. Failure creates a communication restriction which is suppressed outside the sphere or behind total cover and resumes on eligible re-entry/exposure without another save.
operational.effect: An affected creature cannot voluntarily assert as true a proposition it currently believes false with intent to deceive. The prohibition covers speech, writing, sign and another actual language-capable communication method; it grants no new communication ability and requires no shared language with the caster. An attempted deliberate false assertion cannot be voluntarily communicated; the creature may choose a lawful statement or silence. It can refuse, remain silent, evade, omit facts, answer narrowly, use literally true misleading wording, state sincerely mistaken beliefs, identify another person’s words as a quote, or use obvious fiction/jokes/hypotheticals not presented as true facts. It need not reveal a secret or provide useful answers.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in range, targets, duration, magnitude or uses.
operational.limitations: No forced speech, objective-truth test, memory search, hidden-belief access or magical disclosure of who saved/failed/is affected is created. The affected creature recognizes its own inability only when it attempts the prohibited assertion, without learning new facts. Existing written records, earlier statements and other people’s observations are not rewritten; ordinary observable behavior remains ordinary evidence, not magical certification. The Divination placement’s behavioral restriction is not magical information acquisition, so Protection from Scrying does not itself authorize lying; independent Divination information effects retain their own protections. The Enchantment placement does not acquire Divination classification. Independent zone casts keep distinct saves, durations, concentration and exposure records; restriction does not stack magnitude, and one successful save does not defeat a different cast. No Charmed, compelled Action, hard-denial use, harm-ending clause or automatic source-rank upgrade is added. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_CONTROL_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md defines first eligible exposure, independent save histories, temporary total-cover suppression and resumption. The sphere's center stays fixed; moving/teleporting a creature does not move the zone. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Pay a legal cast before effect resolution; failure/countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Resolve hidden eligibility after commitment without a diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No automatic scaling, generic upcast, resource generation or extra action budget.

NEW: unified geometry/procedure with concentration minute, CHA harmonization for the unspecified Divination save, one save per exposed creature/application and exact deliberate-assertion scope. The higher Divination price is preserved as an explicit open balance/source redundancy, not an invented extra benefit.
